rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for any person who does something, with the result applying to all of them.
Use this when whoever means the person who carried out the described action, without highlighting the universal condition.

example.jyutping: bou3 ming4 ge3 jan4 ho2 ji5 jap6 coeng4

rows.note: Use this when you want to make the “no matter who” meaning explicit.

example.english: Whoever you are, you can join in.
example.jyutping: mou4 leon6 bin1 go3 dou1 ho2 ji5 caam1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this for an emphatic spoken question such as “Who ever thought of that?”
